description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX socket accept behavior, including invalid socket, no connection, not bound, and not listening scenarios.

methods.name: PosixSocketAcceptTest.RainyDayInvalidSocket
methods.description: Tests accept() with an invalid socket descriptor (-1).

methods.name: PosixSocketAcceptTest.RainyDayNoConnection
methods.description: Sets up a listening socket and verifies accept() returns error when no connection is made.

methods.name: PosixSocketAcceptTest.RainyDayNotBound
methods.description: Tests accept() on a socket that is not bound or listening, expecting an error.

methods.name: PosixSocketAcceptTest.RainyDayNotListening
methods.description: Sets up a socket, binds but does not listen, then verifies accept() fails.
